title: Vocabulary in literary context
subtitle: Choose a sense from phrase, paragraph, and genre.
overview: At B1, dictionary work should become disciplined: begin with lexical form, observe construction and collocation, then select a sense that fits the paragraph.
A theologically important word does not carry every possible meaning into every occurrence. Context narrows the range.

sections.title: Context narrows sense
rows: world, people, or ordered realm; context decides
glory, honor, splendor; phrase and genre guide the sense

items.grc: ὁ μένων ἐν τῇ ἀγάπῃ ἐν τῷ θεῷ μένει.
items.en: The one who remains in love remains in God.

items.grc: οὕτως γὰρ ἠγάπησεν ὁ θεὸς τὸν κόσμον.
items.en: For God so loved the world.
